interpretation: The current official hero page and July 2026 release describe 讨怀; the 十周年 classic 狼灭 variant is a different product/version and is not registered here.
Rank comparison uses the entire owner hand immediately before the actual Use pays its physical materials, reconstructed from trusted native movement facts; tied extrema qualify.

Only actions whose complete physical cost originates in the owner hand qualify. Zero-material virtual uses and mixed hand/equipment costs do not qualify. Real Dodge and Nullification uses qualify; played Slash responses and recasts do not.

The public yin state is read from the exact skill instance at the native Use declaration (or actual response acceptance). Native Slash commitment precedes its later finalized-target CardActionAcceptedEvent, so qualification reads the owning live window Action rather than waiting for that event. The ordinary shared toggle is applied for an actual draw or chosen discard, and a declined discard does not toggle. This follows the general conversion-skill activation interpretation; no character-specific official FAQ clarifying the otherwise clause was found.
The source page includes separate highlighted 阳/阴 texts and the otherwise-discard sentence in both modes.
